employees.evidence: We are equally invested in the success of our firm and our colleagues.

dei.evidence: A diverse workforce is indispensable to our creativity and success.

environment.evidence: we run our business sustainably and responsibly

community.evidence: We are deeply invested in the success of all of our stakeholders – our clients, our employees, our shareholders, and the communities where we operate

integrity.evidence: We hold ourselves and each other to the highest standards of excellence.

innovation.evidence: Since our founding, innovation has been at the center of how we deliver performance and stay ahead of our clients’ needs.

result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, first-person plural voice with absolute phrasing ('come first', 'highest standards'). Clients are addressed first, then the firm and colleagues. Innovation and performance are framed as core identity. Sustainability is a brief hedged-free mention. Safety and environment are largely absent. Distinctive wording includes 'One BlackRock' and 'emotional ownership'.
